methodology.historicalCoverage: All recoverable dates represented in the legacy and multi-timeframe journals or saved daily report records.
methodology.verified: The existing daily runner writes delivered=true only after its Telegram delivery helper succeeds; an explicit telegramConfirmed=false overrides that legacy marker.
methodology.reconstructed: Daily totals rebuilt from individual journal records; this does not prove a Telegram daily report was sent.
methodology.missingData: Dates with no surviving journal or saved report records cannot be recreated and are not fabricated.
methodology.populations: Legacy 15-minute and multi-timeframe observations remain separate; combined totals are not executed trades or account profit/loss.
